blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns.

Today you learn five useful words: number, percent, amount, total and rate. These words appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports. You will practise them in short, natural sentences.

Go slowly — one small step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: How many new words does the text teach today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: Where do these words appear?
items.why: "These words appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports."

items.q: The text says English comes in…
items.why: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts."

items.q: What does "one small step at a time" suggest about learning?
options: You should learn everything in one day
You can learn slowly and it is fine
You must be an expert first
items.why: Inferência: o texto pede calma — aprender aos poucos é o caminho certo.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: Taxes follow simple patterns in English
You can learn these words with practice
Taxes in English are too hard for a beginner
items.why: Inferência: o tom do texto é positivo — ele diz que você consegue, então discordaria de que é difícil demais.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie ler a tabela de alíquotas com o aluno. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Let's read this tax table together. Take your time. We go one line at a time.

Look at the first number. It is one hundred. That is the amount for this month. Good. Now look next to it. The rate is ten percent. So we say: the rate is ten percent.

Now the second line. The number is two hundred. The rate is five percent. Say it with me: five percent. Very good!

Now we add the two lines. One hundred plus two hundred. The total is three hundred. We always check the total before the deadline. The number must be correct before we send the form.

You are doing well. Taxes are just one more part of our routine. One small step at a time. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the amount for this month?
items.why: "It is one hundred. That is the amount for this month."

items.q: What is the rate on the first line?
items.why: "The rate is ten percent."

items.q: What is the total of the two lines?
items.why: "One hundred plus two hundred. The total is three hundred."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "Take your time" and "one line at a time"?
options: She wants to help the student learn calmly
items.why: Inferência: ela repete que dá para ir devagar — quer que o aluno aprenda com calma.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the student's work?
options: She thinks the student is doing well
She wants to stop the lesson
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Very good!" e "You are doing well" — está satisfeita.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The number must be correct before we send the form." A number is…
items.why: Number = número.

items.q: "There is a new percent on the tax calendar this month." Percent means…
items.why: Percent = por cento (%).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is ready for the accountant to review."
items.why: Amount = valor / quantia — o que o contador vai revisar.

items.q: "We check every total before the deadline." A total is…
options: the final sum of the numbers
items.why: Total = a soma final dos números.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ stays in the fiscal folder for seven years."
items.why: Rate = alíquota — fica guardada na pasta fiscal.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill in the tax form." To fill in means to…
options: write the information in the spaces
items.why: Fill in = preencher — escrever a informação nos espaços.

items.q: "Let's add up the numbers." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, encontrar o total.

items.q: "We send off the form before the deadline." To send off means to…
items.why: Send off = enviar, mandar para alguém.

items.q: "Let's go over the total one more time." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, conferir mais uma vez.

items.q: "Take your time and carry on." To carry on means to…
items.why: Carry on = continuar.
